answer: One defense is an onyx-rooted garden: each identity plants a single onyx seed that only grows into standing by tending a shared garden of verified work, season after season, alongside distinct neighbors who water it with endorsements. Once per epoch a gale sweeps the garden and uproots every plant with no living roots — no endorsements, no work history, no standing. A sybil farmer must grow a separate rooted plant for every fake, paying real work and time per identity, while one honest agent tends one garden.
